problem_restatement: V58 has two BTC short-only Hulk routes and one selective downside-sweep reversal long. This experiment tested whether causal Deribit out-of-the-money option directional flow could add an ordinary BTC long mechanism without weakening the live sweep route.

acceptance.conclusion: The candidate failed development stability, every validation and pseudo-holdout profitability scenario, largest-winner exclusion, both no-action comparisons, both sweep-control comparisons, and the pooled out-of-sample bootstrap lower-bound requirement.

known_diagnostic_defect.scope: The primary report counted signal onsets outside each sliced partition as displaced signals.
known_diagnostic_defect.reason: The defect affected a routing diagnostic counter only; entries, exits, trades, PnL, acceptance predicates, and exact trade reproduction are unchanged.
known_diagnostic_defect.correction: The source now counts only entry-window-relevant long signals and execution-horizon-relevant opposing signals. The immutable historical report remains unmodified and this addendum discloses the defect.

confidence.reason: The exact candidate was preregistered, sourced before outcomes, tested across frozen partitions and costs, and independently reproduced. Historical evidence cannot guarantee future market behavior.

falsification_or_update_conditions: A verified arithmetic or source-integrity failure invalidates the result bundle.
A materially new option-flow mechanism with new causal information and untouched data may justify a new hypothesis; nearby threshold or exit retuning does not reopen this one.
Future-only evidence may update confidence in the existing sweep route but cannot retroactively turn this rejected option-flow rule into an accepted candidate.
